parsed.explanation: This division combines a 2025 birth-sex facility rule in state-run schools and buildings—a tier-1 universal exposure in covered settings—with a religious-refusal law allowing businesses to deny LGBTQ service and no state gender-identity public-accommodations or hate-crime protection. National entry screening can scrutinise or refuse document discrepancies, and national custody records document severe harm, though those are not universal for tourists. National hate-crime and employment protections plus patchy local ordinances partly mitigate. Enforcement of the facility law, especially custody 'accommodation,' is unresolved, and no local arrest pattern is documented. Exposure is real and largely unremedied, but narrower than jurisdictions with all-public-facility bans or organised police targeting.
